title: What You Should Know before a Tummy Tuck in Louisiana

html:
Most people go for a tummy tuck to remove excess skin or fat in the abdominal region. Some people opt for a tummy tuck in Louisiana after a major weight loss episode or in response to a post-surgery scarring. Whatever your motivation, Hanemann Plastic Surgery offers this cosmetic procedure for patients looking to contour and flatten their stomach. Done right, this cosmetic procedure allows for a smoother overall abdomen area, resulting in a more appealing appearance.
A Little Bit about Tummy Tuck Procedures
Whether you are feeling uncomfortable about your overall appearance, excess skin, or lack of results after exercise, this procedure can greatly boost your self-esteem. While this procedure is not designed for weight loss, it specifically targets the skin and fat in the area around the abdomen. During the procedure, our surgeon will focus on removing unwanted skin and fat to leave you with a flatter and more toned abdomen.
Important Facts about Tummy Tuck in Louisiana
1. Your appetite will be affected
A little known fact about this cosmetic procedure is that it is quite normal for you to have a reduced appetite immediately following the procedure. This is because the surgery causes abdominal muscles to tighten internally resulting in a decrease in appetite. This, in turn, results in a slight decrease in body weight after the surgery. However, it is important to understand that tummy tuck is not designed for overweight people who are looking to lose weight fast.
2. Liposuction can help
A tummy tuck is a great cosmetic procedure for individuals who want to flatten their stomach area. However, it is not designed for other areas of the body. Liposuction contours the areas around the abdomen, waist, and thighs. Your surgeon may even recommend liposuction as a solution to create the overall effect you are looking for.
3. A tummy tuck is not for massive weight loss
While a tummy tuck can help you drop a few pounds, it is important to understand that this cosmetic procedure will not change your weight in a dramatic manner. Therefore, it is important that you choose this procedure strictly for body sculpting purposes, and not for losing weight.
A tummy tuck can help you get rid of excess skin in the abdominal area especially after weight loss or after childbirth. If you are considering tummy tuck in Louisiana and would love to learn more facts about this cosmetic procedure, our skilled staff at Hanemann Plastic Surgery can help. We are conveniently located in Baton Rouge. Contact us today to schedule your consultation!
